name: Umber Hulk

additionalSources.name: D&D Dungeon Master’s Guide (2000), Confused condition

evidence: Table A–51 grants burrow at class level 5, gaze at 7, and Large size and 10-ft. reach at 9. At 9 the class has 6d8 Hit Dice and CR 4. The table caps tremorsense at 60 ft. at 14th level, resolving the prose’s reference to a nonexistent 17th level.

name: Air Elemental

additionalSources.name: D&D Monster Manual (2000), Air Elemental and Whirlwind

evidence: Air Elemental, Large labels the endpoint of one class. At level 5 the creature is Medium, with 4d8 Hit Dice, CR 2, Whirlwind, and a 1d6 slam. Whirlwind uses the core 3.0 rules with the damage and saving throw adjustments on p. 153.
catalogStatus: Existing monster or beast record only at the batch baseline.

name: Imp

additionalSources.name: Tome and Blood (2001), polymorph self, p. 95

evidence: Table A–29 grants one polymorph form that persists at later tiers, and at-will self-only invisibility at class level 4. The selected class level has 3d8 Hit Dice, perfect 30-ft. fly speed, DR 5/silver or holy, and no access to regeneration or later powers.
catalogStatus: Existing monster or beast record only at the batch baseline.

name: Rakshasa
evidence: Table A–41 separates class level from sorcerer casting. At level 8, it has 4d8 Hit Dice, CR 6, casting as Sorcerer 4, 3/day detect thoughts, alternate form at will, DR 10/+2, and immunity through 3rd-level spells. The blessed-crossbow-bolt weakness is explicit in the 3.0 player rules.
